name: kata-cc
description: Kata work tracking for Claude Code: a Kata-backed todo tool, delegate tracking, a plan band and a live inbox

liveInbox.title: Live inbox
liveInbox.description: Deliver requests sent to this session through kata notify as they arrive, without waiting for the next prompt. On unless this is off or KATA_CLAUDE_LIVE_INBOX=0; either one turns it off. When off, the inbox is read once per prompt.

refGuard.title: Refuse Kata refs in repository content
refGuard.description: Refuse a write, an edit or a git commit that puts a Kata ref the session knows into the repository: refs resolve only in the local tracker. On unless this is off or KATA_REF_GUARD=off (or 0); either one turns it off.

contract.title: Kata contract in prompts
contract.description: Add the Kata contract and the inbox to each prompt from this plugin. Leave off when `kata agent-hook install claude` is set up: it owns both, and with both on the model reads the contract twice.

contractSource.title: Kata contract source
contractSource.description: A file whose text replaces the Kata contract. Applies only with `contract` on. A relative path is read from the session folder. Blank: KATA_CONTRACT_SOURCE, else Kata's built-in contract. A file that does not exist gets one warning and the built-in contract.

kataExecutable.title: Kata executable
kataExecutable.description: The Kata executable this plugin runs. Blank: KATA_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE, then `kata` from PATH. The Bash tool is not rewritten to use it.

debugFile.title: Debug log file
debugFile.description: Diagnostic log the plugin writes; it keeps the file's last 1,000,000 characters. Blank: KATA_CLAUDE_DEBUG, else none.
